# Tenjin SDK Guides for LLMs

> Self-contained integration guides for the Tenjin SDK (mobile attribution and analytics), written for AI assistants and coding agents. Each guide covers installation, initialization, verification from the device log, event tracking, and common mistakes for one platform.

If you don't know the target platform, start with the platform router guide, which explains how to detect the platform from project files and routes to the right guide.

A Tenjin app is one bundle ID on one platform, so a project that ships on iOS and Android needs two SDK keys. Each guide gives the command that returns the current SDK version; do not use a version from memory.

## Guides

- [Platform router](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/llm-guide.md): detects the project's platform and routes to the platform-specific guide
- [iOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/ios/llm-guide.md): Swift/Objective-C integration via SPM or CocoaPods, including ATT support
- [Android](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/android/llm-guide.md): Kotlin/Java integration via Gradle (Groovy, Kotlin DSL, version catalogs)
- [Flutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/flutter/llm-guide.md): Dart integration via the tenjin_plugin package on pub.dev
- [Ionic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/ionic/llm-guide.md): Capacitor plugin integration via ionic-capacitor-tenjin on npm
- [React Native](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/react-native/llm-guide.md): integration via react-native-tenjin on npm, for bare and Expo projects
- [Unity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tenjin/sdk-llm-guides/main/guides/unity/llm-guide.md): C# integration for Unity projects via the Unity Package Manager
